turnout.notes: Colorado turnout rows use official Secretary of State Historical Election Data 2024 General Voting Statistics county rows normalized from the voter-statistics CSV download. Total Voters equals Active Voters plus Inactive Voters in all 64 counties and equals the former EAC registered-voter denominator statewide.
